correctness.rationale: For any finite connected n-vertex G (n>=2), the private leaf v-prime forces selecting at least one of {v,v-prime} for each v; a semipaired dominating set must have even size, yielding 2ceil(n/2) lower bound. In a tree T, repeatedly remove and pair either two leaf siblings at distance two or the unique terminal leaf and its adjacent support vertex at distance one, maintaining a tree; induction yields a matching saturating all or all but one vertex in T². A spanning tree of G transfers these distance<=2 pairs to G. Choose V(G) for even n or V(G) union unmatched leaf for odd n. Independent enumeration checked the exact minimum for all 771 labeled connected G of n=2..5.
